summary: Equities went into Jackson Hole on the front foot. NQ closed up 0.69% and ES up 0.30%, both near session highs for a second straight day, with the ATR stops rising underneath. Crude was the standout, up 1.97% as the long off the 80 base extended toward 84, while gold stayed heavy under a falling stop and finished roughly flat after dipping to 4,586. The whole tape now waits on Friday's Warsh keynote, so the read is trend-up but stretched into a real event.
psychology: Two days of new highs into a Fed event is where discipline gets tested. The temptation is to chase the breakout up here, or to short it just because it looks extended. Neither is a plan. Decide your level in advance. The rising ATR stop is the line that says the long is wrong, and it is the reference, not your gut. Size smaller when a known event can gap the tape. Let price come to your level instead of forcing a trade at the highs.

event.name: No scheduled US data release of note; pre-Jackson Hole positioning (weekly jobless claims passed before the open)
event.actual: Weekly jobless claims landed before the cash open without a shock. Equities extended to new highs as the tape positioned ahead of Friday's Jackson Hole keynote.
event.surprise: No data shock. The story is event positioning: index longs pressing new highs into the keynote, gold soft, crude strong.
event.nqReaction: NQ broke its opening range to the upside at 10:20 ET, extended to a 29,707.5 high and closed 29,635.25, up 0.69%. ES closed 7,732.75, up 0.30%, also at new highs.
event.crossAsset: Gold (MGC2!) closed 4,618.6, up 0.11%, flat after a dip to 4,586, still short under a falling stop. Crude rose 1.97% to 83.52 and leads the tape. Ahead: Warsh's Friday Aug 28 keynote is the week's key risk. VIX not pulled this run; vol read is from equity ATR.

risk.sizing: Both index longs are extended and closed near session highs into a Fed event. Do not chase or over-size a stretched close. Keep sizing off the ATR and let the rising stops define risk.
risk.openRisk: Two closes below 29,438 on NQ or 7,715 on ES put those longs on hold. Gold reclaiming 4,637 neutralizes the short. Crude losing 82.41 on two closes flips it back toward 82.
risk.note: Jackson Hole runs Aug 27 to 29. Warsh's Friday Aug 28 keynote is the week's key risk and can gap the tape mid-morning. Reduced posture into the event is prudent. Not financial advice.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN
fullReport.html:
HTA OPEN (NY opening range, 13:30 to 13:45 UTC window): OR high 29,589.5, OR low 29,442.75, width 146.75 points (0.50%). Price broke the OR high at 14:20 UTC (10:20 ET), accepted above it, extended to a 29,707.5 high and closed 29,635.25 near the top. NYVWAP at 29,595 held all session, so buyers stayed in control.

Signals: an upside break-and-go, so the short-only HOF play had no setup, BIR never fired (no close back inside the range), and MID had no first-hour rejection. The read was continuation. For Friday, BIR, HOF, MID and BNC are all eligible (no CPI or FOMC), but the Warsh keynote can hit mid-morning, so keep the first break on a short leash.

fullReport.title: Momentum Breakout
fullReport.html: E3v2 Momentum Long has its filter open, with NQ above its 29,438 stop and the 50-period trend. Price broke the opening-range high and printed a fresh session high into the close, so the momentum read is intact and the regime filter is open (up-trend, ATR not compressed). The one caution is context: the breakout came into a stretched tape one day before a major Fed event, so a fresh long up here is chasing.

fullReport.title: AVWAP Deviation Band
fullReport.html:
AVWAP deviation band (MNQ): AVWAP center 29,613, close 29,635 is about plus 0.6 sigma, inside the plus 1 band at 29,651. That is normal range at the close, not a reversion zone. Intraday the 29,707.5 high did tag the plus 2 band at 29,689 and price faded back inside plus 1 by the close, a shallow give-back in a strong up-trend. Bands: plus 3 sigma 29,727, plus 2 sigma 29,689, minus 2 sigma 29,537, minus 3 sigma 29,499. Volume unavailable on the continuous contract, so the exhaustion read is price-only.

The lesson: a plus 2 tag with the trend usually gives only a small fade. The higher-probability reversions come at plus 3 exhaustion, not with a strong trend.
